newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks turn negative after opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks turn negative after opening higher.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell suddenly in the morning after opening slightly higher on Wednesday on buying of stocks that benefit from the weak yen, such as Japanese multinationals, brokers said.

Shares of Nomura Securities Co Ltd were ask-only after Tuesday's news that prosecutors and the securities watchdog raided Japan's biggest securities house over its part in payments to a client linked to racketeers.
The 225-share Nikkei average fell 166.48 points or 0.92 percent to 18,270.83 at 0024 GMT.
